title: Basket Closure
description: basket-closure/v1: the document a basket-closed event carries: the final status of a trade's collateral account, basket or container once the trade ended, and the evidence of how it closed.

accountStatus.description: CLOSED when the collateral went back to the pledger, or the token was redeemed, at the end of the trade; DEFAULTED when it went to the receiver on a default.

txHash.description: Evidence of the close: a ledger transaction hash, the plan or operation the trade ended on, or trade-ended:<tradeId> when there is none.
